children: Q3 2026 revenue was $2.7M versus $3.0M a year earlier. Net income was $10.5M versus a $34.3M loss, largely due to debt and liability extinguishments and lower expenses; diluted EPS was $2.72 versus a $23.07 loss.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Q3 net income $10.5M vs. $34.3M loss
The earnings swing is largely tied to debt and liability extinguishments and lower expenses, not operating profit.
Q3 revenue $2.7M vs. $3.0M
Revenue declined year over year despite the reported 50% sequential growth; the sequential comparison base was not specified.
Q3 operating loss $3.4M vs. $31.5M
Operations remained loss-making, although the loss narrowed year over year.
Nine-month revenue $6.0M vs. $21.7M
The year-to-date revenue decline highlights that one quarter of sequential growth has not reversed the broader contraction.
Cash $476.6K vs. $42.6K at Dec. 31
Cash increased from year-end but remained low relative to $37.9M in current liabilities.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early-stage growth and turnaround story, but the quarterly profit is largely attributable to extinguishments while operating losses persist. Further evidence would require sustained revenue growth, improved operating results, and cash generation in subsequent quarters.
